SR-001.justification: With a secret in os.environ and env= naming one variable, a caged env prints that variable and not the secret, on macOS 26.6.2 and Linux T1 and T2 from the built wheel; spawn sets only env= entries (bindings/python/src/lib.rs, Cage::spawn).

SR-002.justification: 80 spawns from four Python threads complete; the binding spawns through procage's Rust child sequence and registers no hook that runs in the child (no preexec option exists in the API).

SR-003.justification: An unknown JSON field, an unknown preset, a bad version or relative workspace and an unknown relaxation raise PolicyError; a gap raises CapabilityGapError with the gaps on both systems; the accept hints name options without applying them (test_a_gap_says_which_option_accepts_it).

SR-004.justification: A sleep started by a child interpreter is dead after that interpreter exits; test_collecting_a_run_kills_it shows the same for a collected Run; kill ends a run.

SR-005.justification: The wheel and pypi jobs use actions pinned to full SHAs (workflows gate passes), test the built wheel before upload and publish with pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish in the pypi environment with id-token write and no secret; not yet run, and PyPI's trusted publisher must name release.yml and the pypi environment.

SR-006.justification: Every facts lane runs bindings/python/wheel.sh all (build as released, install fresh, 26 tests and the example); passed locally on macOS and Linux T1 and T2, not yet on the CI lanes.

SR-007.justification: While one thread waits on a one-second run, the main thread ticks more than 100 times; spawn, wait, communicate and violations run inside py.detach.
